bias_targets.methodology: Implemented a sample reweighting mechanism that equalizes loss weights across all samples within a batch to mitigate the bias where longer sequence samples disproportionately influence the total loss during supervised fine-tuning.

Utilized the RAISE (Responsible AI Safety Engine) framework for pre-training data filtration via safety classification models, and implemented a real-time output safety control system for active bias detection and mitigation during model inference.
